subject: Renewal kickoff — mop-up action plan + QBR booking
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Hall <morgan.hall@solsticehealth.com>, Carla Diaz <carla.diaz@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff — mop-up action plan + QBR booking

Hi Morgan / Carla —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I want to kick off the renewal conversation and capture a short mop-up action plan so we can lock dates and any term adjustments. High-level asks below; aim is to have the mutual action plan and QBR slot locked by next Friday (6/5).

Quick context: your current term ends 2026-07-31. You mentioned wanting an 18-month term option and a +25% throughput uplift for peak batches. We also discussed adding live monitoring for the Embeddings pipeline as a paid add-on.

Proposed next steps:
- Internal: produce draft SOW with 18-month pricing and throughput uplift options (Laura / Marissa) — due 6/2
- Security: provide short note on data retention and audit logs for extended term (Monica) — due 6/3
- Customer: confirm preferred QBR windows and any exec stakeholders to invite (Morgan / Carla) — reply with 2x 60-min options
- Legal/Procurement: flag any standard PO or procurement timing constraints (Sergio) — advise by 6/4

Tentative QBR windows (PST):
- Week of 6/8: Tue 9–11am or Thu 2–4pm
- Week of 6/15: Wed 10–12pm or Fri 1–3pm

I attached a draft SOW stub and our QBR agenda template for reference. If you prefer a shorter alignment call first (30m) to scope down the SOW, say the word and we’ll book it.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0162

Attachments: SOW_Solstice_v2.pdf (stub), QBR-Agenda-Template.xlsx (stub)

From: Morgan Hall <morgan.hall@solsticehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Carla Diaz <carla.diaz@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — mop-up action plan + QBR booking

Laura —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers inline: 1) 18-month term sounds reasonable — finance will need the 12- and 18-month pricing; 2) throughput uplift: we expect a 25% average increase but could peak at ~40% during promos, so we'd like a burst policy; 3) for the QBR folks: please include my Director of Ops (Carla) and our CFO (Ben Pratt) if seats allow — I’ve cc’d Carla here.

We can do a 60-min QBR on Thu 6/10 2pm PST or Wed 6/16 10am PST. Preference for 6/10. We’ll also confirm any PO lead in procurement early next week.

Thanks — Morgan
Morgan Hall
Head of AI Platforms, Solstice Health
morgan.hall@solsticehealth.com

Thanks Morgan — 6/10 at 2pm PST is penciled. I’ll send a calendar invite and an updated draft SOW for your finance review by EOD Tuesday (6/2) as promised.

Internal notes / asks to the team (Marissa / Monica / Sergio):
- Marissa: I’ll need the 12m vs 18m pricing grid and an example staircase billing option we can offer finance (deliver 6/2).
- Monica: short note on retention + audit logs for extended term + confirmation whether the live monitoring add-on affects data residency (deliver 6/3).
- Sergio: if procurement needs a specific PO reference or contract amendment template for an 18m term, can you surface that so we don’t delay (deliver 6/4).

Also flagged for legal: if we add burst capacity for promotions, we should include explicit burst SLAs and a price-per-burst-token table in the SOW. Marissa, can you draft that section?

I’ll attach the updated SOW and send the calendar invite after Marissa confirms the pricing grid.

Laura
